subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Sara about her problem

4860301.text: What do you think this is, kiddo, a fruit juice store?

4860302.text: Hmph. How rude! Especially since we're here to HELP!

4860303.text: Help? Oh yes, you're the Acting Grand Master's new hotshot helper, aren't you?

4860304.text: Uh... That's one way of putting it, but—

4860305.text: Great. Tell Jean I need my quarterly tax return forms then.

4860306.text: It's time to get Elzer onto doing the accounts again... I must say though, the tax rate on alcohol in Mondstadt is pretty steep.

4860307.text: Do you really need to get Jean involved with stuff like this?

4860308.text: And yet the Dawn Winery is somehow so very rich.

4860309.text: That's mostly down to Master Diluc's successful business model.

4860310.text: Why are the accounts with Jean? Does she do bookkeeping now too?

4860311.text: Acting Grand Master Jean personally goes over all the accounts.

4860312.text: After all, the wine industry is Mondstadt's main source of income. Jean takes great pains to make sure no detail is overlooked.

4860313.text: Paimon never knew that. Jean's job is even harder than it seems.

4860314.text: The Acting Grand Master's hard work indeed makes our lives a whole lot easier.

4860315.text: We're certainly very lucky, but... to put it bluntly, we just take it for granted that that's the norm now.

4860316.text: Wow... How do you sleep at night knowing how much pressure you put Jean under?

4860317.text: *sigh* When you put it like that I do feel quite ashamed... I suppose I should give her one on the house next time she's here.

4860318.text: Although... I doubt the Acting Grand Master even has the time to spare for that.

4860319.text: Sounds like a poor excuse to deny Jean a free drink...

subQuests.subQuestName: Pass the citizens' commissions on to Jean

4860502.text: Margaret! What are you doing here?

4860503.text: My cat's gone missing. Have you seen it?

4860506.text: No, not her. I imagine Diona's probably still in the tavern.

4860507.text: I mean little Princey. Prince was just home, now he's gone.

4860508.text: Did you seriously think Diona was a house cat!?

4860509.text: This is a bit worrying. What if Prince can't find his way home?

4860510.text: I would love to help, but...

4860511.text: But we are on our way to an urgent meeting with Jean. Sorry.

4860512.text: I guess we can have a look for your cat.

4860513.text: #Naw, {NICKNAME}. You're always such a big softie. But aren't we in the middle of something?

4860514.text: Sara and Charles need our help urgently, too. Let's go and see Jean first.

4860515.text: You're on the way to see Jean? What a coincidence.

4860516.text: Paimon thought you were looking for a cat?

4860517.text: Yes, I wanted to see if Jean could help look for my cat.

4860518.text: Seriously? You want Jean... to help you look for your cat?

4860521.text: Such a solid line of reasoning...

4860522.text: I feel like this is a classic case of "good people finish last."

4860523.text: Please mention it to Jean for me. I'll treat you to a brew at Cat's Tail later.

4860525.text: Ugh, unbelievable! Guess the case of Prince the missing cat is now added to the agenda for our meeting with Jean.

4860709.text: Oh! It's our Honorary Knight. Sorry, I must have been daydreaming.

4860711.text: Actually, it's not us who need your help. It's a bunch of other people...

4860712.text: I see. Well, thank you for your service to the people of Mondstadt. *cough*

4860713.text: I have made a note of these commissions in my files and I will... make arrangements...

4860716.text: We didn't miss out anyone's commissions, did we?

4860717.text: Sara's hilichurls, Charles' tax return, Margaret's cat... Seems that's everything.

4860718.text: We'll be on our way then, Jean— Jean?

4860801.text: How's Jean holding up? Is it serious?

4860802.text: It's just burnout from work stress. She'll be fine after a good old rest.

4860803.text: Thanks for bringing her here — she may have tried to keep soldiering on otherwise.

4860804.text: It's not a surprise though, she does have a lot to get through every day.

4860805.text: Poor Jean. She has always been one to push herself too hard while overlooking her own needs.

4860806.text: This isn't the first time something like this has happened.

4860807.text: She really has it tough doesn't she. Poor Jean.

4860808.text: Seems like you really care about Jean.

4860809.text: Oh, ah... You think so? I—I mean, she's the Acting Grand Master and all, we can't have her collapsing all the time now can we...

4860810.text: S—So y'know, it's not like this is a personal... thing, it's just out of love for— concern for... the greater good! Yes, that's it!

4860812.text: #...Anyway, you're an honorary knight, aren't you {NICKNAME}?

4860813.text: While the Master is down, the knights should share her burden, no?

4860814.text: That's a very good point, but... Shouldn't one of the fully-qualified knights do that?

4860815.text: Jean has so much to do, an extra pair of hands can't hurt.

4860816.text: You should go and check in at the <color=#00E1FFFF>headquarters</color>. Jean will be fine with just me here.

4860817.text: Paimon feels like she's trying to get rid of us...

4860819.text: #Nothing! We'll leave you to it — come on {NICKNAME}, let's go.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

4861003.text: I have been informed about Jean falling ill. On behalf of all of the Knights of Favonius, allow me to express my sincere gratitude for your assistance.

4861004.text: So courteous and polite. This isn't the Kaeya Paimon knows.

4861005.text: Haha... Well, the circumstances warrant it. This is the Acting Grand Master herself we're talking about.

4861006.text: Now, in addition to that thank-you message, there was one other thing...

4861007.text: You have a job for us?

4861008.text: It's like you read my mind! We have quite a connection, don't you think?

4861009.text: Is this the part where you give us our reward?

4861010.text: Hahaha. I must say I like your style.

4861011.text: But before we can discuss a reward, there are some things I hope you can assist the Knights with.

4861012.text: Things like helping to fill in for Jean?

4861013.text: Right. Although the commissions you reported to Jean have already been handed off to someone else...

4861014.text: ...I am concerned that they will not be handled with due care without Jean's personal touch.

4861015.text: So I am hoping that you can help out where you see fit.

4861016.text: I will feel much more at ease knowing that the Honorary Knight is personally overseeing these cases.

4861017.text: #You can flatter {NICKNAME} all you want, but answer me this — why don't YOU do it!?

4861018.text: Haha... Oh, I have far more important matters to attend to. There are so many things to... to prepare.

4861019.text: Hmph. Fine then. So it's <color=#00E1FFFF>Sara, Charles and Margaret's</color> stuff you want us to help with, right?

4861020.text: Those are the ones. I appreciate the help. See you later!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Margaret and ask about the commission

4870101.text: ...So, yours is the cat that went missing.

4870102.text: Venti! Have you come to help?

4870103.text: Me, here to help you? Why, on the contrary, it is I who needs helping!

4870104.text: But Paimon just saw you talking to Margaret about Prince...

4870105.text: Aha! So, Prince is the name of the feline fiend who thieved my spare <color=#00E1FFFF>astral iron strings</color>!

4870106.text: Though it gladdens my heart to see that the free-spirited ethos of Mondstadt is alive and well in creatures great and small... Still, it's a bit audacious!

4870107.text: Haha, Prince is a mischievous little rascal alright!

4870108.text: Spoken just like a parent who chooses to spoil said rascal!

4870110.text: Ahaha, yes, quite... quite... Ahem! Now, let's see about getting ourselves an audience with his little highness, Prince Rascal of Mondstadt!

4870111.text: I have a performance tonight, and without my spare strings, I shall have to disappoint my audience.

4870112.text: What would a kitty cat want with lyre strings anyway?

4870113.text: Everyone knows cats go crazy for a ball of string!

4870115.text: These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy. That makes them extremely durable, so I normally just roll them up in a ball to make them easier to carry.

4870116.text: That's a trick of the trade from a traveling bard!

4870118.text: #That'll help us! {NICKNAME}, it's time for you to use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> again!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Charles and ask about the commission

4880001.text: Lisa? Are you here about the tax return?

4880002.text: Oh, hello darling. You're quite right. After I heard about poor Jean, I thought I might lend a hand with some of her more literary duties.

4880003.text: Cool, well if we're no longer needed here, we'll be on our way.

4880004.text: Oh wait a moment... Actually, Charles here was wondering—

4880006.text: I just took a rather important order, but unfortunately we've run completely dry and the delivery from the winery is behind schedule.

4880007.text: If it's not too much trouble, could you go and <color=#00E1FFFF>do something about this logistical nuisance</color>?

4880008.text: What's so urgent about this order?

4880009.text: *sigh* It came in at the last minute. Literally, just a few seconds ago.

4880011.text: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

4880012.text: Okay, but my next drink here had better be on the house!

4880013.text: Heh... I'm positive that next time my boss Master Diluc is here, he'll pick up the tab for you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find Sara and ask about the commission

4890101.text: Got it. I'll set off right away!

4890102.text: Amber! Are you here to help out with Jean's commission?

4890103.text: Oh, hi. Yeah, I was just getting ready. Who better than an Outrider to mop up some hilichurls on the delivery route?

4890105.text: Sara... What are you still stressing about? I'm an Outrider, and I won't disappoint!

4890106.text: You misunderstand me. I don't doubt your abilities, I'm just overwhelmed at the number of orders piling up in front of me.

4890107.text: Another bizarre order came in just now. It's like they're hosting a banquet or something...

4890109.text: Is there anything we can help with?

4890110.text: I can help with the cooking!

4890112.text: That would be wonderful! You really are the Good Hunter's guardian angel.

4890113.text: Yeah well... Those hilichurls are going to be a handful, too.

4890114.text: Well, why don't you take this order. Start by getting the ingredients.

4890115.text: #Are you sure {NICKNAME} can be trusted? It might end up tasting a bit funky...

4890116.text: We're well past the point of aiming for perfection. This is now a fight to save the Good Hunter's business.

4890118.text: For this dish, we need... <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sweet Flowers and three Fowls</color>.

4890119.text: Okay, go and get ready. You too, Amber. I'll be waiting here.

4871001.text: Prince! Good boy, that's my Prince, I knew you'd come home to me...

4880301.text: Thank you, my friend. I thought I was in deep trouble this time. It's a good thing you showed up.

4880302.text: I'll put in a good word for you with the gentlemen at the winery.

4890501.text: Is it ready? Let me see, let me seeee!

4890502.text: This is a very good effort. I think you really captured the essence of what the dish is all about.

4890503.text: Are we released from kitchen duty now?

4890504.text: Yes, thanks ever so much for your help. Amber should be able to take care of everything else.

4890505.text: If you ever get tired of being an adventurer, there'll be a job waiting for you at Good Hunter if you want it!

4861401.text: I already told you, I can take care of Jean on my own. Please help Jean out by completing her tasks.

4861101.text: The customers are getting hungry. Please be quick.

4861201.text: Jean's overworked? Yes, relatively speaking you guys have a lot more time on your hands.

4861301.text: Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. It's a black cat you're looking for.
